scope: Android connection page, connection policy, recovery entry points and related UI tests
rootCauses: A persistent UNKNOWN local pairing result disabled LAN/Direct selection while remote mode hid the recovery entry.
The primary remote connect button reused a local pairing guard despite the SSH entry point allowing remote recovery.
LAN connect reused Wi-Fi Direct permission to manage a group, rejecting a confirmed phone hotspot.
UI could change its Direct selection after ViewModel rejected the mode change.
behavior: Idle users can view all three methods with historical local uncertainty; selection sends no pairing or wireless-group commands.
Shared policy protects actual connections; remote connection is independent of historical local uncertainty.
Actual local connection remains blocked pending local confirmation; recovery appears in every method.
Connected/control-active/busy/mutating states retain guards and explain the action needed.
Main action and SSH state precede collapsible login and network details; passwords remain masked by default.
Same-method selection preserves receive-only video intent; mode change does not erase control or pairing recovery.

physicalPhone.finalState: Connection page in remote mode, SSH disconnected, app foreground

initialUiAssertionsAdapted: Password rendering is checked through TextLayoutResult, retaining password input semantics.
Motor field locks are checked after selecting their existing category/section.

remainingLocalState: The genuine prior UNKNOWN pairing record is intentionally retained; use the visible recovery action before local SSH or wireless-group changes.
